svg.aria-label: An evidence card from the pilot: pagination-bounds, merge-ready. Checks exit 0; the regression test failed at base and passes at head; integrity found nothing; the strong model reviewed once and would merge; the auditor passed after driving 7 steps in its own session; browser rendering was not verified, and the card says so.
